name: Calcite Flow

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves

disable: DC 23 Performance check (trained) to shatter the calcite using the resonant powers of the consonite crystals plus DC 23 Athletics check, DC 23 Nature check, or DC 23 Survival check (trained) to dam the flow of water.

items.name: Mineral Glaze
items.text:
Trigger An unattended inanimate object enters the path of the calcite flow

---

Effect The object gains a thin shell of calcite. Breaking the shell using physical damage will harm the object underneath.

text: A seep of mineral-rich water coats any unattended objects in a layer of calcite.
